observation: Ten-seed rank ensembles per encoder were GATv2 0.961737/0.961672, GraphSAGE 0.956696/0.962935 and TransformerConv 0.951702/0.953550. Mixing GATv2 and GraphSAGE 60/40 gave 0.964279/0.966011 and 50/50 0.963577/0.966330; the transformer added no gain, and intervals overlap widely, so F-0020 called 60/40 the candidate rather than a proven lift.
